title: CaT-Movie: Balancing Global Planning and Local Rendering for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
title_zh: CaT-Movie：平衡全局规划与局部渲染的长时多镜头视频生成
abstract_en: Current multi-shot video generators render only limited durations per pass, requiring long movies to be stitched from local segments across which narrative progression and visual identity drift. To synthesize long-horizon movies with Coherence across Time, we present CaT-Movie, a multi-shot generation system consisting of a global story planner and a local window renderer. The planner expands user requests via a large language model to preserve, infer, and complete story details, while deterministic code maintains the resulting storyboard across shots to compile self-contained shot prompts and index reference frames from generated history. To execute this guidance, the renderer applies reference-routed sparse self-attention and shot-wise cross-attention to route identities from the indexed frames while isolating per-shot textual conditions. Given the scarcity of high-quality open-source multi-shot data, we construct a dataset of over 350K film shots annotated with semantic state transitions, entity grounding, and multi-granularity requests. We further build CaT-MBench, a benchmark on held-out films with the same annotations. It gives every baseline its native format and counts cross-shot consistency only when a cut opens a new camera setup, preventing repeated framing from passing as consistency. On CaT-MBench, CaT-Movie attains the highest average score and the most consistent characters among all methods. The project page is available at https://jinplu.github.io/CaT-Movie/.
abstract_zh: 现有多镜头视频生成器单次只能渲染有限时长，拼接局部片段时容易出现叙事衔接不畅、角色外观漂移等问题。CaT-Movie 将长时视频生成拆分为全局故事规划与局部窗口渲染：规划器利用大语言模型保留用户明确指定的细节、推断隐含信息并补全情节，再通过确定性程序维护跨镜头故事板，为每个镜头编译可独立使用的提示词，并从已生成的画面中索引参考帧。渲染器通过参考路由稀疏自注意力（reference-routed sparse self-attention）传递角色等实体的身份信息，并通过逐镜头交叉注意力（shot-wise cross-attention）隔离各镜头的文本条件。作者构建了包含超过 35 万个电影镜头的标注数据集，并基于留出影片建立 CaT-MBench。该基准允许各基线沿用原生输入格式，仅在切镜后采用新机位的情况下计入跨镜头一致性，避免重复构图被误判为一致。CaT-Movie 在该基准上获得最高平均分，角色一致性也优于所有对比方法。
key_points_zh: 全局规划器用大语言模型补全故事，再以确定性程序维护故事板、编译逐镜头提示词并索引历史参考帧。
局部渲染器用参考路由稀疏自注意力延续实体身份，用逐镜头交叉注意力避免不同镜头的文本条件相互干扰。
训练数据包含超过 35 万个电影镜头，标注涵盖语义状态变化、实体定位和不同粒度的生成请求。
CaT-MBench 只在切换到新机位时计入跨镜头一致性；CaT-Movie 的平均分和角色一致性均居对比方法首位。
